title: Prove sharp conditioning of the complete complex port (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped all-width proof with exact finite corroboration. The complete two- and three-call dirty-input ports from Dugongue's #4743 have sharp Euclidean condition number

    previous bound: 16
    exact value:    (11 + 3 sqrt(13))/2

Both norm and inverse norm equal (sqrt(13)+3)/2. An explicit two-dimensional invariant Gram sector attains the extremes at every positive tensor width. The package also gives the full singular spectrum with exact multiplicities. The classical shear singular-value calculation is the method; the new result is the sharp constant and spectrum for these particular complete ports.

Only research/complex-port-sharp-conditioning is added. Paid calls and the selected frontier are unchanged. This contribution is produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Dugongue #4743, Yiyang #4710, lee-phys #4688 and Jacob Alan Sussman #4628, with their predecessor credit retained by citation.

## Evidence

Before, FULL-INPUT-PORT.md bounds each endpoint norm by 4 and the condition number by 16. After, the written singular-value decomposition and attaining vector prove the exact smaller constant.

From the repository root:

~~~sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/complex-port-sharp-conditioning/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/complex-port-sharp-conditioning/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-port-sharp-conditioning
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complex-port-sharp-conditioning --check-source-history
~~~

All pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64. Each registered check is timed locally at 0.067 s and 0.066 s. Expected mathematical status: PASS_COMPLEX_PORT_SHARP_CONDITIONING.

The independent Gaussian-integer computation covers literal 16-, 128- and 1,024-row shear matrices at widths 1, 2 and 3. It checks the new Gram polynomial, both inverse orders, exact spectral-projector traces and the sharp sector. Squared-coupling multiplicities for d=1,5,9 are (2,2,4), (18,24,22), (140,224,148). Six rejection controls pass. A generated scratch receipt binds the five final package files by SHA-256. No predecessor verifier is imported or replayed. The source-history preflight passes for the pinned canonical base 624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43.

The current selected source-binding orientation passes. The card's historical control was attempted and fails with KeyError: 'complex_profile' under the changed selected schema; it is recorded and unchanged.

## Limitations

Exact Euclidean endpoint conditioning is proved. Internal Gaussian gate cuts, coordinatewise rounded-call error, complete recursive substitution, changed nonunitary encodings, full-unit admission and an integer multiplication theorem remain outside scope. No Lean or other proof-kernel check, full supplier replay or independent human review is claimed. The inherited native costs, restoration and workspace remain those of #4743.

## Open next questions

- Propagate the sharp endpoint constant through one complete recursively substituted word, retaining every intervening mixer.
- Derive the native schedule's sharp coordinatewise error amplification from an actual rounded Gaussian call contract.

## Related open work

- #4628 supplies the small-unit model and lower-bound context; this result changes a local conditioning constant rather than its call bounds.
- #4813 studies a complete cascade using the #4743 ports. This result tightens the component bound 16 for the frozen two-bank port and does not establish cascade correctness or its condition number.
- #4818 studies a block-4 cascade with different letters. Its complete-cascade conditioning claim is a different quantity; this package does not compute it.
- #4819 studies the block-4 boundary cascade. Its loop conditioning and call-count claims are outside this theorem.
- #4797 changes the coupling to the resonant P_f+Q_f pencil. This theorem concerns P_f+2Q_f and retains the full two-bank interface.
- #4825 studies the rank of #4797's partial channel at width four. No partial-channel rank is computed here.

- #4829 uses the same classical block-shear singular-value formula to bound internal dirty Toeplitz FFT cuts. This result instead gives the exact complete two-bank port spectrum; it computes no FFT cut norm.
- #4835 determines the characteristic-zero two-column GL3 address-algebra kernel in the same small-unit context. Its image-rank quantity differs from this complete port's Euclidean conditioning, and no numerical comparison is made.

This account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-22 21:12:45 UTC were refreshed before DONE. No conflicting same-port conditioning value was found in that snapshot.

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated research package.
